summary: Design agent completed Low-Level Design for FR-PERF-001 (Issue #26) — Maintain >=60 FPS with 500 bricks using InstancedMesh and BVH raycasting. LLD covers: InstancedBrickManager (swap-and-pop O(1) slot management, 512-slot GPU buffer pre-allocation per brick type), BvhRaycastManager (three-mesh-bvh integration, 50ms debounce rebuild, SAH strategy), enhanced PerformanceMonitor (p95 ring buffer, heap tracking, draw call tracking, raycast latency), FrameScheduler singleton (single rAF loop), performanceStore Zustand slice, PerformanceOverlay dev HUD, memory management (zero-allocation render loop, disposal protocol), Vite bundle optimization (manual chunks, tree-shaking), TypeScript interfaces, 4 sequence diagrams, error handling (WebGL context loss, BVH failure, performance.memory fallback), security considerations, test case mapping for T-PERF-PERF-001-01/02/03 and T-PERF-PERF-003-01, and measurable NFR targets. Draft PR #57 is open on branch feature/26-fr-perf-001-design awaiting Gate 6a human design review before merge to main. Area determined as frontend (pure client-side SPA).
